prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: orthographic texture-source albedo painting for the Hesper conductor ring.
Input image 1 (design_reference.png) is ONLY the approved design, material and colour reference. Input image 2 is the EDIT TARGET, the exact orthographic model guide. Paint directly over image 2; its geometry wins over image 1.
Change surface colours and fine material details ONLY. Keep the guide's silhouette, all inner-hole boundaries, every strand crossing and part edge, framing, size, position, camera and visible/hidden parts EXACTLY. Preserve the guide's original alpha mask pixel for pixel. Do not rotate, straighten, round off, recenter, enlarge or redesign it. Do not copy the reference's camera or more elaborate geometry.
Materials: all the guide's pale yellow braided conductor wires become the reference's warm brushed gold base colour, with restrained fine brushed grain and subtle wear. The light grey/white head becomes warm white ceramic with fine wear and small panel joins, matching the reference. Gold trim stays within the existing head silhouette. Any visible light-tone emitter becomes bright cyan/blue-white with a narrow dark blue-violet resin inset; only where the guide has an emitter. Hidden faces plausibly continue the same materials. Guide tints only identify materials and are not colours to copy.
Lighting: UNLIT ALBEDO, flat even shadowless viewer light. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no darkening at crossings or inner ring, no directional illumination, no white specular stripes, no strong highlights, reflections, rim light, bloom or glow spill. Gold shows its base colour with at most a faint sheen. Light elements are painted as bright colours.
Output: a single 1024 x 1024 RGBA painting, genuinely transparent background and ring hole, original guide placement. No background, floor, text, letters, numbers, labels or watermark. No parts outside the original guide silhouette.
View-specific geometry: FRONT VIEW: retain the wide oval ring spanning x=66..957, y=204..819. The ceramic head is partially hidden behind the top strands, its visible upper cap at the top centre. Do not reveal the emitter or add a faceplate in front of the obstructing gold strands.
reason: Selected: normalized guide-mask overlap 98.8%, substantially better than correction (72.1%). Strong highlights and recessed shading remain; best available raw return, not fully brief-compliant.

checks.comparison_note: Guide and output sampled at corresponding normalized canvas positions for diagnostic comparison only; saved output is the original unresized tool return. A high overlap is not pixel identity.
checks.lighting_review: Visible facet light/dark shading remains; some returns also retain metallic highlight strokes.
checks.materials_review: Gold conductor wire, worn ivory ceramic and cyan/blue-violet emitter where visible follow the design palette; painted surface detail reviewed visually.
checks.alpha_review: Real transparency is present, but generated low-alpha fringe/speckles extend beyond the main shape; source alpha was not preserved exactly.
